actual_cell_deltas.after: B4-03 R110: R1/R2: MRI-Forensics is independently constructed and documented with reusable generator/split and detector evaluation protocols, beyond an experimental pool. Evidence and limitations retained in B3-03/per_paper/R110.json.

actual_cell_deltas.before: With this assertion, we develop a new forensic detection framework that combines Autoregressive Image Models and Discrete Wavelet Transform (AIM-DWT) analysis that reliably detects AI-generated manipulations.
actual_cell_deltas.after: Construction and evaluation: PDF pp3-8, Tables1-3. Prostate Table2 is fake-only; Table3 separately evaluates real brain images. Patient-level independence, clinical validity, release and reported performance are not independently reproduced.

B4-03 R171: R1/R2: CommGen15 independently collects and standardizes commercial-platform outputs and defines a reusable external-training image-level evaluation resource. Evidence and limitations retained in B3-03/per_paper/R171.json.

actual_cell_deltas.before: To address this challenge, we propose the Peak-Guided Calibration (PGC) framework.
actual_cell_deltas.after: Table1, section3, section5.1, AppendixC and Table10: 19,472 native images and 13,922 video-derived frames; 33,394 generated plus 33,394 COCO real. Nine static-image and six frame subsets remain distinct; frame correlation and platform/version limitations remain. Acc/AP evaluation does not establish independently reproduced performance.

B4-03 R256: R1/R2: CSAIID is a separately constructed cross-semantic resource with defined categories, real/fake sampling, generators and reusable external-training evaluation protocol. Evidence and limitations retained in B3-03/per_paper/R256.json.

actual_cell_deltas.before: We propose Adaptive Test-Time Semantic Debiasing (ATTSD), a zero-shot approach that utilizes the visual-semantic space of large pretrained vision-language models to dynamically align feature representations during testing-without requiring additional training data or annotations.
actual_cell_deltas.after: Section4 and section5, Table1: six categories with 1,000 real and 1,000 fake each (12,000 total), COCO/PartiPrompts and SDv2/LDM/LCM. A global 1:1:1 balance is arithmetically possible; exact per-category allocation is unspecified, not disproved. Changes in training regimes do not isolate semantic causality; results are not independently reproduced.

B4-03 R275: R2 only: GenImage++ is an independently specified reusable test benchmark with new generator/prompt strata and evaluation protocol, not merely a large result table. Evidence and limitations retained in B3-03/per_paper/R275.json.

actual_cell_deltas.before: It also introduces the GenImage++ evaluation benchmark and reports improved cross-generator performance without redesigning the detector network.
actual_cell_deltas.after: Contributions, section5, section6 and AppendixC.2-C.4 pp19-22 define nine strata (138,900 from rounded counts). Benchmark is generated-only with no matched reals: Table3 measures positive-class recognition, not balanced real/fake accuracy or specificity. R1 dataset label is not added; reported performance is not independently reproduced.

B4-03 R564: R1 only: DF3 is an independently constructed reusable fake-face resource with documented base generators and post-processing, beyond method-training usage. Evidence and limitations retained in B3-03/per_paper/R564.json.

actual_cell_deltas.before: To address this issue, we propose a Global and Local Feature Fusion (GLFF) framework to learn rich and discriminative representations by combining multi-scale global features from the whole image with refined local features from informative patches for AI-synthesized image detection.
actual_cell_deltas.after: Contribution list, sectionIV and TableI pp6-7: 6,160 base fakes; 46,476 tabulated derivatives versus approximately 46,400 in prose; six protocols include unprocessed originals. Fake-only DF3 and 1,000 separate FFHQ real controls remain distinct. arXiv v7 author version is not verified publisher-final equivalence. No benchmark or task label is added; release availability is unverified.
